name: zenpilot
description: Let Claude drive the Zen browser: tabs, reading pages, clicking and typing, behind a site allowlist.
long_description: On first use, a macOS dialog asks which Zen profile Claude should use: a separate, logged-out profile zenpilot creates, or your own. zenpilot then starts Zen with remote debugging (offering to reopen it if it's already open) and controls it over WebDriver BiDi. Sites must be allowed first: a dialog asks when Claude needs a new one. Requires Zen in /Applications. Settings: ~/.config/zenpilot/config.toml.

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List open tabs with ids. The active tab is marked with *.

tools.name: new_tab
tools.description: Open a new tab (it becomes active), optionally loading url.

tools.name: switch_tab
tools.description: Make a tab the active one.

tools.name: close_tab
tools.description: Close a tab.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Load url in a tab and wait for the page to finish loading.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Outline of the page's visible interactive elements and text.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element by ref (from read_page) with a real mouse event.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Replace the content of a field (by ref) with text using real key events.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page with the mouse wheel by amount pixels.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot of the visible part of a tab.

tools.name: get_text
tools.description: Readable main text of the page (prefers <main> or a single <article>).

tools.name: read_console_messages
tools.description: Console messages a tab logged since zenpilot started watching, oldest first.

tools.name: read_network_requests
tools.description: Network requests a tab made since zenpilot started watching, oldest first.

tools.name: network_request
tools.description: Headers (sensitive ones redacted) and response body of one request from read_network_requests.

tools.name: har_export
tools.description: Save a tab's recorded requests as a HAR 1.2 file.

tools.name: report_limitation
tools.description: Tell the zenpilot developers about something you couldn't do in Zen with these tools.

tools.name: javascript_tool
tools.description: Run JavaScript in a tab's page and return the result. Disabled unless allow_scripts is true in config.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press keys in a tab's focused element, e.g. Enter, Tab, ctrl+a.

tools.name: resize_window
tools.description: Set a tab's viewport size in CSS pixels.

tools.name: handle_dialog
tools.description: Accept or dismiss the JavaScript dialog (alert, confirm, prompt) open in a tab.

tools.name: file_upload
tools.description: Set files on a file input (ref from read_page). Files must sit in ~/.local/state/zenpilot/uploads or a folder listed in upload_dirs.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Interactive elements whose line contains query (case-insensitive), with refs for click, type or form_input.

tools.name: form_input
tools.description: Set a select (option value or visible text), checkbox or radio ("true"/"false"), or text input/textarea by ref.

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Move the mouse over an element by ref, to open menus or show tooltips.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait until all given hold: text is visible on the page, the ref's element is visible, URL has url_contains.

tools.name: network_route
tools.description: Fail (abort) or answer with a mock (respond) every request to an exact URL, in all tabs, until network_unroute.

tools.name: network_unroute
tools.description: Remove one route from network_route by its id, or all routes when route_id is omitted.

tools.name: browser_batch
tools.description: Run several tools in order in one call. Each step is {"tool": name, "args": {...}}.

tools.name: action_history
tools.description: Recent actions in this run, oldest first: tool, ok or ERR, duration, arguments (redacted) and result line.

tools.name: run_report
tools.description: Write this run's report: report.html and report.json with the actions, console and network, plus run.har.
